scope: 1 mm high by 10 mm wide sharp bump at 100 mm/s; B+S = 2 kg; true contact force error <= 0.5 N for the entire recording.
robotTravelMeasurement: Modeled noisy/delayed S-relative-to-A position supplied to both loops, zeroed at the chosen operating equilibrium; no separate magnet measurement.
invalidReason: Toolhead sensor and observer/dead-time initial offsets were inconsistent with the nonzero initial gap offset; the slow loop was also supplied tool position instead of an inferred coil gap. These runs are excluded from controller/hardware conclusions.
